## Goal
The request guard (`src/freemyid/wizard/server.py:172-207`) is tested route by route for a few routes (`tests/test_wizard_server.py:38`, `tests/test_security_wave2.py:142,187`, `tests/test_security_wave3.py:91`). Nothing enumerates `app.routes`, so a new POST route (there are 22 today, `server.py:309-877`) gets no automatic guard check.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. Build the app with `create_app` (`server.py:139-152`) on the `store` fixture and use `TestClient`; enumerate every route whose methods include POST from `app.routes`, filling path parameters with fake ids. Assert at least 22 routes were found so the sweep can never silently cover nothing.
2. For every POST route: missing CSRF -> 403; wrong CSRF in the form and in the `x-csrf` header -> 403; `Origin: http://evil.example` and `Origin: http://127.0.0.1:<another port>` -> 403; a bad Host header -> 403 (174-176); no session cookie -> 403 even with a valid CSRF token (177-186); a `?t=<token>` query on a POST never logs in (179 is GET-only). `Origin: null` must be refused too (188-189); if it is accepted, strict xfail with that line.
3. Every refused request leaves the store unchanged (profile, to-do, request and event counts before and after).
4. The GET `?t=` login sets the session cookie HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, path `/` (180-182).
5. At least one harmless POST with the right cookie, Origin and CSRF passes the guard (for example `POST /_focus`, 630-638), proving the test can tell pass from refuse.

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Offline: no network, no sockets (FastAPI `TestClient` is fine), no git, no installs, no new dependencies. Tests must pass on Windows CI too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp`, no `/`-joined path strings or other POSIX-only assumptions (WO-217 broke windows-latest that way). The module under test is outside Codex's code lane: a real product bug = `pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason=...)` plus a finding with file:line in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit it. Check `tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/` and `tests/grok/` first and don't duplicate a guard. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing; re-check them in your worktree.
